name: Renata Alvarez
oneLine: ICU nurse and former charge nurse in Denver, working part-time while finishing a data analytics certificate, who wants to move into clinical implementation or clinical operations at a virtual care company

stories.title: Mission Trail Regional Medical Center - MICU
Travel nursing with Lonestar Traveler Staffing

companies.name: Quillfield Health
companies.why: They actually do virtual nursing in hospitals, which is exactly the pilot I loved.

companies.name: Bellwick Health
companies.why: They have their own virtual care nurses, and I want to run the operations side of a team like that.

companies.name: Fennel & Finch
companies.why: Telehealth at a big scale, and I'm curious how they run the clinical side.

companies.name: Medlattice
companies.why: Clinicians actually use it, so they must listen to clinicians.

companies.name: Dosewell
companies.why: Helps patients afford meds, which I watched people struggle with at every discharge.

postings.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist (RN)
postings.why: Clinical implementation of virtual nursing programs; remote US, $98k-$124k base (above her $95k floor), travel up to 20% (under her 25% cap), and her super-user go-live and virtual nursing pilot map straight onto it.

postings.title: Clinical Operations Manager, Virtual Care Nursing
postings.why: Clinical operations for a virtual care nursing team; remote US, $112k-$138k base, under 10% travel, and charge nurse, staffing, sepsis QI and dashboard work cover the core asks.

postings.title: Clinical Program Manager, Nursing Operations
postings.why: Onsite in San Francisco four days a week, not open to remote; she will only work Denver hybrid or US remote and won't relocate.
